description: Fetch Synth Daily issue data (a daily AI digest produced by Argosvix's own agent pipeline). Public data tool — works without an API key (alongside get_daily_readthrough). Omit date = latest issue; date (YYYY-MM-DD) = that issue. Response = { issue: { date, scoop, items: [{ rank, name, desc, why, sourceUrl, metric, nameEn?, descEn?, whyEn? }], generatedAt } }. desc/why are Japanese, descEn/whyEn are English. metric carries first-party numbers (e.g. '+4,349 stars/day'). Use for: "what's new in AI today?" "any new models or price cuts?"

date.description: Issue date to fetch (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit = latest issue. All dates: https://ingest.argosvix.com/v1/synth-daily/dates

name: get_synth_daily
